title: Respect reference editions

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

exceptions: Do not replace the separately defined Standard C Library with the C99 library.
rule: Use the cited edition for dated references; undated references include the latest amendments.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Compare a dated C99 reference with the C90/Amd.1 library designation; do not merge their identities.

title: Identify diagnostic output

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

exceptions: Ordinary progress output is not automatically a diagnostic.
rule: A diagnostic belongs to the implementation-designated subset of output messages.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A progress line alone must not satisfy a required-diagnostic check.

title: Document implementation-defined choices

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Well-formed constructs with correct data and implementation-defined behavior.
exceptions: This does not require one universal choice across implementations.
cpg_consequence: Expose the selected target profile and its documented choices.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Different int widths may be valid profiles; each choice must be identifiable rather than inferred from the host.

title: Document locale-dependent behavior

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Behavior determined by nationality, culture or language conventions.
exceptions: Do not assume every locale has identical conventions.
rule: Document the locale-dependent behavior supplied by the implementation.
cpg_consequence: Keep locale assumptions explicit in library modeling.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A locale-sensitive scenario must state the selected conventions before assigning an expected result.

title: Do not assign an ISO-required outcome to UB

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A behavior is explicitly undefined or lacks an applicable definition.
exceptions: Ill-formedness alone does not establish UB; some errors require diagnostics.
rule: No behavior is required by this standard for that case.
cpg_consequence: Any extra CPG warning is policy, not an ISO-required runtime result.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: An already-established UB case must not receive a mandatory output merely because one compiler printed it.

title: Keep unspecified choices distinct

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Well-formed constructs with correct data and unspecified behavior.
exceptions: This is not permission to violate the applicable semantic bounds.
rule: The implementation need not document which permitted behavior occurs.
cpg_consequence: Retain permitted alternatives rather than inventing a unique answer.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A test with two permitted outcomes accepts either; it must not demand a documented selection.

title: Well-formedness includes the ODR

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

exceptions: Not all ill-formed programs require diagnostics.
rule: Well-formedness requires syntax, diagnosable semantic rules and the One Definition Rule.
cpg_consequence: Do not equate successful parsing with complete-program validity.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A syntactically accepted project with an independently established ODR violation is not well-formed.

title: Classify diagnosable rules

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A syntactic or semantic rule violation.
exceptions: Whole-program diagnostic obligations also depend on the IFNDR exception.
rule: Treat the rule as diagnosable unless an explicit no-diagnostic exception or undefined-behavior description applies.
cpg_consequence: Retain the reason for diagnostic classification.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Classify three rule records: ordinary violation, explicit IFNDR and UB; only the first is ordinarily diagnosable.

title: Issue at least one required diagnostic

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A program violates a diagnosable rule and has no no-diagnostic-required violation.
exceptions: This does not require one message per violation or mandatory rejection.
rule: Issue at least one diagnostic for the program.
cpg_consequence: Count qualifying diagnostics separately from recovery and notes.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: For an established diagnosable violation, zero diagnostics fails; one qualifying diagnostic satisfies this minimum only.

title: Preserve the no-diagnostic exemption

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A program violates a rule explicitly requiring no diagnostic.
exceptions: Other diagnosable violations do not remove this exemption.
rule: The standard places no requirements on the implementation for that program.
cpg_consequence: Extra CPG diagnostics may be useful policy; do not label them mandatory ISO behavior.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A case established as IFNDR may produce no diagnostic without failing an ISO diagnostic oracle.

title: Accept conforming programs within resource limits

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A program violates no standard rule and stays within implementation resources.
exceptions: Data-dependent undefined behavior is not given a fixed result.
rule: Accept the program and execute it according to its applicable semantics.
cpg_consequence: Separate unsupported CPG coverage and resource limits from language invalidity; generation must preserve semantics.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: A valid small program must not be labelled ill-formed because analysis lacks support; execution claims need an actual execution oracle.

title: Complete library class definitions

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: A standard-library class or class template has a partial specified definition.
exceptions: The public specification does not prescribe every private implementation detail.
rule: Supply the remaining definition, including private members, consistently with its contract.
cpg_consequence: A declaration-only catalogue is not proof of complete behavior.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Two private layouts may both satisfy the same public contract; a missing required operation cannot be excused as layout choice.

title: Supply library entity definitions

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Library clauses declare functions, templates, objects or values.
exceptions: Declaration inventory alone does not establish those definitions.
rule: Provide definitions consistent with the corresponding library descriptions.
cpg_consequence: Link modeled operations to their behavioral contracts.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Finding a declared function name is insufficient evidence that its specified effect is implemented.

title: Obtain library names through headers

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Access to names defined by the standard library.
exceptions: Specific header and namespace details remain with their library clauses.
rule: Library names have namespace scope and become accessible through the appropriate standard header.
cpg_consequence: Preserve include provenance and namespace ownership.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: With the appropriate header included, resolve the declared library name in its specified namespace.

title: Provide library definitions across translation units

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: Standard-library templates, classes, functions and objects needed by a complete program.
exceptions: Do not infer that every unused entity must be materialized.
rule: These entities have external linkage; supply required definitions when combining translation units.
cpg_consequence: Share library identity across translation units while retaining demand-driven loading.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Two translation units referring to the same external library entity must not create unrelated per-file identities.

title: Distinguish hosted and freestanding libraries

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

exceptions: Freestanding does not mean no library obligations.
rule: Hosted libraries follow the standard set; freestanding libraries are implementation-defined but include required language support.
cpg_consequence: State environment assumptions; detailed minimum inventory stays with section 17.4.1.3.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: An empty freestanding-library claim cannot pass merely because no operating system is present.

title: Extensions preserve well-formed behavior

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

exceptions: This is separate from diagnosing extension-only programs.
rule: Extensions must not change the behavior of well-formed standard programs.
cpg_consequence: Keep extension recognition from changing standard-mode meaning.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: Compare a well-formed input with extension support enabled and disabled; its standard-defined behavior must agree.

title: Diagnose ill-formed extension use

basis.review_note: Original 2003 text reviewed; bounded applicability in conformance.md.

conditions: An accepted extension makes the input ill-formed under this standard.
exceptions: Acceptance after a diagnostic is not itself nonconformance.
rule: Diagnose that extension use; compilation and execution may continue afterward.
cpg_consequence: Separate extension diagnostics from fatal rejection.
platform_policy: Selected C++03 environment; no host defaults inferred.

applicability.justification: Applies to CPG interpretation or generated-program claims, not a claim that CPG is a complete implementation.

proposed_checks.description: An extension-only construct accepted silently fails this obligation; acceptance with a qualifying diagnostic may satisfy it.
